title.narrative: Technical Assistance for Banking & Financial Services - Peru

description.narrative: The resident advisor is providing assistance to Perus Ministry of Economy and Finance (MEF) with the implementation of Perus National Strategy for Financial Inclusion. Work includes assisting in the development of a digital retail payment ecosystem, supporting Perus Banco de la Nacion toward its goal of digitizing government transactions and payments, assisting with the development of regulations to promote the development of financial instruments for micro, small, and medium-sized enterprises (MSMEs), and supporting the development and adoption of a new range of innovative financial products targeted specifically at Perus financially excluded and underserved population.
